info.title: Nudge API
info.description: HTTP API for Nudge, an open-source, self-hostable task manager.

get.description: Report whether the API and its database are working.
Return the signed-in user, or no user, and set the CSRF cookie the frontend needs.

post.description: Start a session for the user with these credentials.
End the current session.
Change the signed-in user's password, keeping this session and ending all others.

patch.description: Change the signed-in user's name and return the updated user.

put.description: Change the signed-in user's time zone and return the updated user.

get.description: Return the user's latest notifications and their unread count.

post.description: Mark one notification as read.
Mark every notification as read.

delete.description: Remove one notification from the notification center.

post.description: Notify the user, to check that notifications reach their devices.

get.description: Return the key browsers need to subscribe, if the server has push set up.

post.description: Push the user's notifications to this browser.

delete.description: Stop pushing the user's notifications to this browser.

post.description: Create an expanded Folder last in the sidebar.

patch.description: Rename a Folder, or collapse or expand it.

delete.description: Delete a Folder for good; its Projects stay, ungrouped, where it was.

post.summary: Move a Folder in the sidebar
post.description: Put a Folder right after a top-level sibling, or first.
Create a Project last in its Folder, or last in the sidebar.

patch.description: Rename, recolour or change the icon of a Project. The Inbox can't be changed.

post.summary: Move a Project in the sidebar
post.description: Put a Project in a Folder or on the top level, right after a sibling or first.
Make a Project read-only and move it to the sidebar's Archived section.
Bring an archived Project back to its place in the sidebar, unchanged.

get.description: Return the user's People, A to Z.

post.description: Add a Person to the address book.

patch.description: Rename or recolour a Person. A rename shows in every Mention of them.

delete.description: Delete a Person for good; their Mentions become plain `@Name` text.

post.description: Fold a Person into another: their Mentions move over and they are deleted.

get.description: Return the Inbox, Folders and ungrouped Projects in order, then archived Projects.

get.summary: List a Project's or a Person's Tasks
get.description:
Return the open Tasks of a Project or Person, or, with `closed`, a page of Closed ones.

A Project's Tasks come in manual order. A Person's are the Tasks that mention them, flat, in
each Project's manual order. Closed Tasks come most recently completed first, in pages; open
Tasks come all at once.

post.description:
Add a Task first in its Project, or in the Inbox when no Project is given.

With `parent_id` it is added last under that Task instead, which reopens the parent and its
ancestors if they are Closed.

get.description: Return a Task with everything the detail drawer shows.

patch.description:
Change a Task's fields, returning it and every Task whose Status changed.

Each changed Task comes with its Status and Blocked reason from before, so the client can
offer Undo without the server keeping anything.

post.description:
Move a Task and its Subtasks under a parent, or to a Project's top level, after a sibling.

The server picks the new order key. The Task comes back with every Closed ancestor the move
reopened, so the client can offer Undo.
Add an open copy of a Task right after it, with its title, Description and Priority.

get.description: Return a page of a Task's history, newest first, with the number of events in all.

post.summary: Attach a file to a Task
post.description: Store one file against a Task, up to the configured size.

get.description: Return a Task's Attachments, oldest first.
Send an Attachment's bytes, inline for images and PDFs and as a download otherwise.

delete.description: Delete an Attachment and its file for good.

get.description: Return the signed-in user's feed address, or null while the feed is off.

post.summary: Turn on or reset the Calendar feed
post.description: Give the user a new feed address; any old address stops working.

delete.description: Clear the user's feed address so it stops working.

200.description: The feed as an iCalendar file.

get.description: Return the feed's owner's open dated Tasks as an iCalendar file.
